description: An Early Medieval monastic foundation, reportedly founded by St Moluag in the 6th CE. Although excavations have taken place no remains were identified which can bon confidently assigned to the 6th CE, the earliest remains possibly being destroyed by the later cathedral. It should be noted that the field boundaries around the site form a rough circle, which may indicate an original vallum, similar to other early church sites in the region.
